price_note: Estimated minimum booking value per session (from-price x minimum party size, from the site's published rates). Kiss My Axe hides live prices from its API, so edit these to taste.
A$38 = the published 60-minute bay rate. Each idle bay-hour counts as ~$38 of unsold range time.
note: Capacity venue: 58 bays booked by the half-hour via YourGolfBooking (venue slug moore-park-golf). We track idle bays per operating hour. Hours approximate published times (6am-10pm; Mon from 10am).

NBC Badminton Alexandria (18 courts) via Yepbooking. Capacity venue: free courts per operating hour. Availability is public (no login). id_sport=6 is the Alexandria tab. Court hire is $28 day / $38 evening; price_per_unit_hour is a blended estimate. Polled gently: 1 request/day of lookahead.

Escape rooms (Redfern/Sydney). Custom WooCommerce theme; reads each day's sessions via the game_overview_load AJAX (nonce served openly). Wasted = a session still fully open at start. Polled gently: 1 request/day of lookahead. price_per_empty = min booking value (2 x $65).

price_note: PLACEHOLDER rate per idle court-hour. House of Pickle is membership-priced (members book free; guests pay day-pass fees of $0/$2.50/$5/$7.50 by party size), so there is no clean court-hire price — replace 16 with the real casual court-hire rate, or set to 0 to report occupancy only. Capacity venue: 8 courts (C1-C8) booked by the half-hour via Podplay; availability is public behind an anonymous Firebase token (no login).
